title: Business Office Accounting Note: Refund Checks, Sibling Transfers and Closing a School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
**Retired clauses.** The clause "A positive balance is refunded by district check only on an inactive account, after the student withdraws or graduates, on the household's request, when the balance is at least the refund minimum; the check is mailed within the refund processing days in calendar days" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current refund basis. The clause "A refund always pays out the entire positive balance" is likewise no longer in force and has been superseded by the current refund basis.

**Clauses in force for every School Nutrition Services Meal Account:**

1. A balance below the refund minimum, or any positive balance the household prefers to keep in the district, may be moved to a sibling's account.
2. A balance is moved only to another meal account of the same household that is in status active; the receiving account's household and status are taken from the meal account records.
3. A transfer may be made from an active or an inactive account and never exceeds the giving account's positive balance; unpaid meal charges are never transferred.
4. An inactive account is closed only when its balance is exactly zero, the balance being its deposits, voids and transfers in less its purchases, refunds, transfers out and returned deposits, every transaction from opening up to the moment of the decision; a positive balance unclaimed for 12 months (the unclaimed balance months) after inactivation, with no active sibling account, is applied to the district's student meal assistance fund.

## Transfer test

| Giving account | Receiving account | Transfer allowed |
|---|---|---|
| active or inactive, positive balance | same household, active | yes, up to the giving account's positive balance |
| any | another household, or not active | no |
| zero or negative balance | any | no; unpaid meal charges are never transferred |

## Closing test (hypothetical balances)

| Inactive account's balance | Closed? |
|---|---|
| 0.00 | yes |
| 0.35 | no |
| 2.10 below zero | no |

superseded_clauses: A positive balance is refunded by district check only on an inactive account, after the student withdraws or graduates, on the household's request, when the balance is at least refund_minimum; the check is mailed within refund_processing_days calendar days.
A refund always pays out the entire positive balance.
